name: Nitin Spinners Ltd
about: Founded in 1992 in Bhilwara of Rajasthan, Nitin Spinners is India’s leading manufacturer of cotton yarn, knitted fabrics and finished woven fabrics.
keyPoints:
Business Profile[1]
Established in 1992 and headquartered in Bhilwara, Rajasthan, the company is one of India’s leading manufacturers of Cotton & Blended Yarn, Knitted Fabrics, and Greige & Finished Woven Fabrics. With a presence in 50+ countries and a strong distribution network, it is one of the leading global players in the textile industry.

pros: Company's median sales growth is 15.8% of last 10 years
cons: Dividend payout has been low at 9.61% of profits over last 3 years
